resources:
- name: branches
  type: git
  check_every: 30m
  source:
    version_type: branches
    uri: https://github.com/concourse/examples
    # Could use branch_regex instead if you want
    branch_filters:
      - feat/*
      - feature/*

- name: golang
  type: registry-image
  source:
    repository: golang
    tag: latest

- name: repo
  type: git
  check_every: 30m
  source:
    uri: https://github.com/concourse/examples

jobs:
- name: set-feature-pipelines
  public: true
  plan:
  - in_parallel:
    - get: branches
      trigger: true
    - get: repo

  # creates the ((.:branches)) var
  - load_var: branches
    file: branches/branches.json

  - across:
    # creates the ((.:branch)) var, set to the value of one branch
    - var: branch
      values: ((.:branches))
    do:
      - set_pipeline: ((instance_pipeline_name))
        file: repo/pipelines/multi-branch/template.yml
        instance_vars:
          branch: ((.:branch))

- name: test
  public: true
  plan:
  - in_parallel:
    - get: repo
      trigger: true
    - get: golang
  - task: tests
    image: golang
    file: repo/tasks/go-test.yml
    params: {MODULE: apps/golang}

- name: build
  public: true
  plan:
  - in_parallel:
    - get: repo
      passed: [test]
      trigger: true
    - get: golang
  - task: build
    image: golang
    file: repo/tasks/go-build.yml
    params:
      MODULE: apps/golang
      BINARY_NAME: ascii-banner
  - task: run-binary
    image: golang
    file: repo/apps/golang/binary-test.yml
  # Could then upload the tgz file somewhere like S3

platform: linux

image_resource:
  type: mock
  source: {mirror_self: true}

inputs:
  - name: binary

run:
  path: sh
  args:
    - -cex
    - |
      ./binary/ascii-banner -list
      ./binary/ascii-banner concourse
      ./binary/ascii-banner plane
      ./binary/ascii-banner pilot

platform: linux

image_resource:
  type: registry-image
  source: { repository: golang }

inputs:
- name: repo

outputs:
- name: binary

params:
  MODULE:
  BINARY_NAME:

run:
  path: sh
  args:
  - -cex
  - |
    root=$(pwd)
    cd "repo/${MODULE}"
    go build -o "${root}/binary/${BINARY_NAME}"

    timestamp=$(date '+%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
    tar czf "$root/binary/$BINARY_NAME-$timestamp.tgz" "${root}/binary/${BINARY_NAME}"

platform: linux

image_resource:
  type: registry-image
  source: { repository: golang }

inputs:
- name: repo

params:
  MODULE:

run:
  path: sh
  args:
  - -ce
  - |
    cd "repo/${MODULE}"
    go test -v ./...

# pipemaster:emulated job.runner pipeline/parent/job/test
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '**'
jobs:
  build:
    needs:
      - test
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch) && !github.event.deleted
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: golang:latest
    steps:
      - id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - id: build
        run: |
          (
          set -e
          set -x
          [ -e repo ] || ln -s "$PWD" repo
          mkdir -p binary
          root=$(pwd)
          cd "repo/${MODULE}"
          go build -o "${root}/binary/${BINARY_NAME}"

          timestamp=$(date '+%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
          tar czf "$root/binary/$BINARY_NAME-$timestamp.tgz" "${root}/binary/${BINARY_NAME}"
          )
        env:
          MODULE: apps/golang
          BINARY_NAME: ascii-banner
      - id: run-binary
        run: |
          (
          set -e
          set -x
          ./binary/ascii-banner -list
          ./binary/ascii-banner concourse
          ./binary/ascii-banner plane
          ./binary/ascii-banner pilot
          )
  set-feature-pipelines:
    if: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # pipemaster:lost job.if pipeline/parent/job/set-feature-pipelines: (event == 'push') && (before_sha == '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000') && ((branch =~ '^feat/') || (branch =~ '^feature/'))
      - id: branches
        run: 'printf ''%s\n'' ''pipemaster: lost: step.action pipeline/parent/job/set-feature-pipelines/step/branches: a step of kind plugin has no GHA form'' >&2; exit 1'
      - id: across
        run: 'printf ''%s\n'' ''pipemaster: lost: step.action pipeline/parent/job/set-feature-pipelines/step/across: a step of kind plugin has no GHA form'' >&2; exit 1'
  test:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch) && !github.event.deleted
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: golang:latest
    steps:
      - id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - id: tests
        run: |
          (
          set -e
          [ -e repo ] || ln -s "$PWD" repo
          cd "repo/${MODULE}"
          go test -v ./...
          )
        env:
          MODULE: apps/golang

kind: WorkflowTemplate
metadata:
  name: parent
spec:
  entrypoint: main
  arguments:
    parameters:
      - name: ctx-branch
        value: ""
      - name: ctx-event
        value: ""
      - name: ctx-sha
        value: ""
      - name: ctx-repo
        value: ""

        value: ""
  templates:
    - name: main
      dag:
        tasks:
          - name: build
            template: build
            dependencies:
              - test
            when: '{{= false }}'
          - name: set-feature-pipelines
            template: set-feature-pipelines
            when: '{{= false }}'
          - name: test
            template: test
            when: '{{= false }}'
    - name: build
      containerSet:
        containers:

            image: golang:latest
            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
              - |-

                set -e
                set -x
                [ -e repo ] || ln -s "$PWD" repo
                mkdir -p binary
                root=$(pwd)
                cd "repo/${MODULE}"
                go build -o "${root}/binary/${BINARY_NAME}"

                tar czf "$root/binary/$BINARY_NAME-$timestamp.tgz" "${root}/binary/${BINARY_NAME}"

            args:

            workingDir: /workspace
            dependencies:
              - branches
        volumeMounts:
          - name: workspace
            mountPath: /workspace
      volumes:
        - emptyDir: {}
          name: workspace
    - name: test

        containers:

            command:
              - sh
              - -ec
            args:
